title: Confirmation of a ring structure in the disk around MP Mus (PDS 66) with ALMA Band 7 observations
question: Does the MP Mus disk show a ring in ALMA Band 7 (0.89 mm) dust continuum, and what do the spectral index and the gas versus dust extent imply about radial drift and grain growth?

data.bands: Band 6 (1.3 mm) from two Cycle 5 programs; Band 7 (0.89 mm) from one Cycle 8 program
data.angular_resolution: Beams 0.07" x 0.05" (Band 7) and 0.11" x 0.09" (Band 6) at robust = -0.5; 0.09" x 0.07" (Band 7) and 0.12" x 0.10" (Band 6) at robust = 0.5; about 5 au at 98 pc
data.sensitivity: Continuum rms Band 7: 4.8e-5 Jy/beam (r=0.5), 5.8e-5 Jy/beam (r=-0.5); Band 6: 4.1e-5 (r=0.5), 3.9e-5 (r=-0.5)

what.value: Band 6 (1.3 mm) radial brightness profile (Frank) used for comparison with Band 7

recipe.method: ALMA staff pipeline calibration, then phase-only self-calibration of the extended configurations (continuum, line channels excluded)
key_parameters: Band 7: five phase-only steps, 60 s (x4) and 45 s (x1)
Band 6: four phase-only steps, 35 s (x2) and 25 s (x2)

recipe.goal: Combine compact and extended data for line analysis
recipe.method: Fit 2D Gaussian to find the continuum peak in each dataset, set a common phase center with fixvis/fixplanets, then concat

recipe.goal: Image the dust continuum at 0.89 mm and 1.3 mm
recipe.method: tclean with mtmfs deconvolver, nterms=2, Briggs robust 0.5 and -0.5 on self-calibrated extended-configuration data
key_parameters: robust = 0.5 (S/N and resolution compromise) and -0.5 (finer structure)

recipe.method: Aperture photometry with a 5-sigma mask on the continuum images

recipe.goal: Derive disk geometry and deprojected radial profiles
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fit to the Band 7 continuum for inclination, PA and center; deproject and take azimuthal average in concentric rings

recipe.goal: Reconstruct a super-resolution 1D profile from visibilities
recipe.method: Frank (frankenstein) nonparametric Gaussian-process fit of the Band 7 continuum visibilities

recipe.goal: Measure gas disk radii from CO
recipe.method: Deproject moment 0 images, extract azimuthally averaged radial profiles, take the radius enclosing 95% of the integrated flux
key_parameters: Combined compact+extended line data used for line analysis

recipe.goal: Estimate dust and total disk masses
recipe.method: Optically thin, Rayleigh-Jeans dust mass M_dust = F d^2 / (kappa B(T)) at each band; total disk mass from Cieza et al. flux relations
assumptions: Optically thin emission at scales much larger than 10 au
Gas-to-dust mass ratio of 100 in the Cieza relations

recipe.goal: Derive the integrated and radially resolved spectral index
recipe.method: Integrated alpha from the two band fluxes via F1/F2 = (nu1/nu2)^alpha; spectral index map from joint tclean mtmfs nterms=2 imaging of both bands after aligning phase centers, deprojected to radial profiles
key_parameters: robust 0.5, 0.0 and -0.5 tested for the alpha map
assumptions: Optically thin dust in the Rayleigh-Jeans limit, alpha = beta + 2

recipe.goal: Test whether the Band 7 ring is visible at Band 6 resolution
recipe.method: Convolve the 0.89 mm image to the 1.3 mm beam after aligning phase centers, and inspect convolved and residual images; also make an r^2-weighted brightness profile

recipe.goal: Interpret gas versus dust extent and compare with opacity theory
recipe.method: Compare R_gas/R_dust to the criterion for dust evolution and compare scattered-light and mm profiles with Birnstiel et al. 2015 predictions

score_reason: Projects and key CASA settings (tclean mtmfs, robust, CASA 5.6.1, self-cal solints) are given, and the main results are numeric, but image/mask/threshold settings, line-free channels, aperture size and Frank hyperparameters are missing and public status is not stated by the paper.
rediscovery_reason: Three ALMA projects are named and linked in the archive, the recipe covers calibration, self-cal and tclean choices, and results (fluxes, dust masses, alpha, gas radii) are numeric and recomputable, though some imaging details need to be inferred.
